newEntry.name: Tumble & Tray
newEntry.desc: Snip 28 runners, seat two alternating inclined baffles between pierced cheeks and lower into a tray for a seven-panel miniature gravity tower. Measured sheet/socket reference, calibrated fits, local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL grips; connected-card, per-part STL and ZIP. Adhesive and external 6 mm bead/die required; flow physically untested.
